info.title: Queue OpenAPI for microsoft/moge-3
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the microsoft/moge-3 queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Estimate metric monocular geometry (point map, depth, surface normals,
camera intrinsics/FoV) from a single image using MoGe-3, and optionally
export a textured mesh (.glb) and colored point cloud (.ply).

image_url.description: Input RGB image to estimate geometry (point map, depth, normals) for.
image_url.title: Image Url

fov_x.title: Fov X
fov_x.description: Optional known horizontal field of view in degrees. If provided, MoGe uses it instead of estimating the camera FoV.

apply_mask.title: Apply Mask
apply_mask.description: If true, mask out invalid (sky/background/uncertain) regions in the predicted point map, depth map and normal map.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Enable safety checking of the input image.

resolution_level.title: Resolution Level
resolution_level.description: Processing resolution level (0-9). Higher values use more tokens for finer detail but slower inference. Output size always matches the input.

num_refinement_steps.title: Num Refinement Steps
num_refinement_steps.description: Number of sparse 3D refinement passes over the predicted depth. 0 skips the refiner and returns the coarse MoGe-2-style prediction.

edge_threshold.title: Edge Threshold
edge_threshold.description: Relative threshold for removing mesh edges across depth discontinuities. Smaller values remove more edges.

export_ply.title: Export Ply
export_ply.description: If true, export a colored .ply point cloud of the reconstructed geometry.

export_glb.title: Export Glb
export_glb.description: If true, export a textured .glb mesh of the reconstructed geometry.

fov_y.title: Fov Y
fov_y.description: Vertical field of view in degrees.

fov_x.title: Fov X
fov_x.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees.

mask.description: Binary validity mask (PNG); white where geometry is valid.

point_cloud.description: Colored .ply point cloud of the reconstructed geometry (when export_ply=true).

model_mesh.description: Textured .glb mesh of the reconstructed geometry (when export_glb=true).

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
